title: The Passage of Devil's Throat
author: Orsen Joubert
blurb: August Okafor, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
